settings.title: Soft From the First Wear
settings.text: A new tee shouldn't need ten washes to feel right. Ours are finished soft before they leave the factory.
settings.points:
Bio wash: natural enzymes polish away the loose surface fibres that turn into bobbles
Silicone wash: a softening finish that gives the cotton its smooth, silky feel

settings.title: Pre-Shrunk Before It's Sewn
settings.text: Cotton shrinks the first time it meets water, so we give it that water first. Every cut panel is laundered before a single stitch goes in.
settings.points:
The shrinking happens at our factory, not in your machine
Each panel is washed on its own, not just the finished tee

settings.title: Stitched Like Premium Basics
settings.text: A tee gives up at its joins first, so that is where the most care goes.
settings.points:
Taped neck and shoulders, so the seams that take the most pull keep their shape
Overlocked side seams, finished so the edges don't fray
Flatlock and coverstitch finishing that lies flat against skin
Double-needle hems: two rows of stitching on every hem

settings.title: Colour That Stays Bright
settings.text: Our colours are lab tested for colour-fastness in the wash, and every print is made with OEKO-TEX certified inks.
settings.points:
Colour-fastness tested in a lab
OEKO-TEX certified inks on every print

settings.title: Safe on Little Skin
settings.text: What touches your child all day should be simple and checked.
settings.points:
100% organic cotton
OEKO-TEX certified inks
BIS certified
Sized for ages 4 to 12

settings.heading: Built Like Premium Basics. Sized for Kids.
settings.intro: Soft from the first wear, pre-shrunk before it's sewn, and stitched the way the best grown-up basics are. Here is everything that goes into a JJW tee before it reaches you.
